text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still-chan! Thank you for the wonderful 
birthday present!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. With this size, is it sweets 
inside? That's so like Still-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. With the aroma of fermented butter 
and a delicate, melting texture. It's a 
biscuit... with cream sandwiched inside.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That masterpiece may have a simple flavor, 
but it has passionate fans. So I... tried 
putting my own twist on it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Still-chan...! Would you like to 
share these biscuits with me?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Gaining fans through simplicity and being 
loved for a long time. That's... the exact 
same thing local idols aim for!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to eat, chat, and tell me 
everything. About your ideas for recipe 
twists, Still-chan... and your love!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
! My... love...? ...A-Are you... really 
sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Bring it on with all you've got! 
I'll take it head-on with everything I 
have!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufufu... Yes. If I can be of 
assistance, I shall answer your call. With 
all the love I have."
